Section Name: anonymous_networks
Corresponds to: Anonymous Networks
This section is available in the Premier and Advantage editions.
Key
Value
anonymous_access_behavior
Defines what happens when a user on
an anonymous network attempts to
access resources. One of no-action
(default), require-mfa , or deny .
anonymous_ip_access_device_only
Determines if the Duo Mobile
authenticating device IP is considered
for rule evaluation. If true , anonymous
network enforcement uses the access
device IP only. If false  (default),
enforcement applies to both access and
authentication device IP addresses.
anonymous_ip_excluded_networks
List of IP Addresses, IP ranges, or CIDRs
that are not considered as anonymous
and will be excluded from being
blocked.
